paper.title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
paper.central_claim: FDKA将重复失败转为受治理的符号过程补丁，冻结模型并在后续任务消除同类结构故障；在所测域保持高成功率和可审计回退。

provenance.notes: 派发为sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无可独立验证的运行回执或session标识，不探测模型。

evidence.quote: Its contribution is therefore narrower but more concrete: governed, weight-frozen structural repair of process knowledge rather than broad self-evolution over arbitrary agent components.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者把最近邻残余定位到 typed symbolic process repair。

evidence.quote: A deterministic parser validates JSON structure, extracts the edit type, and type-checks against the operator schema. Invalid outputs are rejected immediately.
evidence.support_explanation: LLM只提案，解析和类型检查是外部硬边界。

evidence.quote: Every committed patch carries a provenance record (source, inputs, rationale, timestamp) enabling forensic trace-back; all edits are versioned with deterministic rollback sets.
All agents solved the holdout tasks episodically, but only
evidence.support_explanation: 任务成功与根故障消除不是同一指标。

evidence.quote: patches BookFlight API-drift on first encounter (TTA=0); target failures plateau at 1 while baselines accumulate 9 across prefix and holdout.
evidence.support_explanation: 后续任务上留存的补丁降低同根故障复现。

evidence.quote: This is paraphrased same-root recurrence at the instruction surface, not renamed-field or sibling-operator variation, which remain out of scope under the content-addressed
evidence.support_explanation: 留出只支持同根故障而非新结构转移。

evidence.quote: All systems share identical planners, parsers, and domain ontologies; differences lie in adaptation mechanisms.
evidence.support_explanation: 共享符号底座，有针对性的FDKA消融但无同权限同预算替代补丁器。

evidence.quote: The current manuscript mixes single-seed and 3-seed evidence.
evidence.support_explanation: 多种子但样本与重复范围有限。

evidence.quote: broader formal significance testing across more domains and seeds is deferred to future work and should accompany any stronger generalization claims.
We do not make strong cost-ratio claims here because the current telemetry for token and latency accounting is incomplete in some scenarios.

Stage 1: Input serialization.
Only predicates relevant to the failure are included
evidence.support_explanation: 提案者可见局部operator和失败证据，并非无限源代码。

evidence.quote: When fewer retrieved examples are available, the system enters a low-power mode using the available examples and/or deterministic suite and rejects on any observed failure.
evidence.support_explanation: 低功效canary并非统计保证，gate数据与proposal不完全独立。

evidence.quote: Under full governance, the migration is escalated before commit on all six tasks; under the governance-off stress ablation, the first such patch is committed and the remaining tasks recover without further proposals.
evidence.support_explanation: 治理确实改变部署决策，但以6/6恢复为代价，不等于长期安全已证。
治理审计样本只有8，且Table6/正文的commit/escalate计数口径不一。
按公开0.4/0.25/0.25/0.1公式仅为0.788；示例的aggregate不一致。

signatures.information: 失败trace、operator快照、至多10相关符号、检索历史；固定typed schema和领域ontology可见
signatures.operation: 责任打分定位operator，GPT-4o-mini生成三种typed patch，确定解析后做score/guardrail/canary
signatures.conditions: 可表示于既定operator schema且有可执行模拟器
signatures.feedback: 执行错误、回放utility、canary和后续成功失败
signatures.selection_rule: score≥0.18且无veto，风险/低置信转人工，canary通常≥0.8；低样本拒绝任一观察失败
signatures.selection_data: 最多20历史trace、最多8 canary；并未证明二者均与提案数据独立
signatures.persistence: 规则池与content-addressed ledger，provenance/rollback set/Beta trust
signatures.later_use: HTN重新编译并在后续任务使用新operator
signatures.claimed_effect: 同root复发故障在6任务holdout降至0
signatures.failure_boundary: 不同schema hash/兄弟operator要各自重修；高风险可全部阻断

signatures.operation: hard veto/人工升级/canary；低trust标记回退
signatures.conditions: 可信且覆盖足够的规则、canary
signatures.selection_rule: 风险>0.6或score<0.5送人工；trust<0.3经10任务回退
signatures.claimed_effect: 避免静默安全敏感迁移
signatures.failure_boundary: 没有实际rollback压力测试；8例远不足广泛安全保证

E.holdout.reason: 有后续6-task同root与paraphrase测试，不是新root/兄弟operator或严格独立长期holdout。

E.statistics.reason: 3种子均值标准差及bootstrap区间/检验，满足A2的3档；根故障和独立seed数仍小。
